verses.original: לֹֽא־ תִרְאֶה֩ אֶת־ שׁ֨וֹר אָחִ֜יךָ א֤וֹ אֶת־ שֵׂיוֹ֙ נִדָּחִ֔ים וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם הָשֵׁ֥ב תְּשִׁיבֵ֖ם לְאָחִֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯir·’eh ’eṯ- šō·wr ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’ōw ’eṯ- śê·yōw nid·dā·ḥîm wə·hiṯ·‘al·lam·tā mê·hem hā·šêḇ tə·šî·ḇêm lə·’ā·ḥî·ḵā
verses.literal: If you see your brother’s ox or sheep straying you must not ignore it . . . be sure to return it . . . to your brother
verses.literalPt: VENDO extraviado o boi ou ovelha de teu irmão, não te desviarás deles; restituí-los-ás sem falta a teu irmão.

verses.original: וְאִם־ לֹ֨א קָר֥וֹב אָחִ֛יךָ אֵלֶ֖יךָ וְלֹ֣א יְדַעְתּ֑וֹ וַאֲסַפְתּוֹ֙ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֔ךָ וְהָיָ֣ה עִמְּךָ֗ עַ֣ד דְּרֹ֤שׁ אָחִ֙יךָ֙ אֹת֔וֹ וַהֲשֵׁבֹת֖וֹ לֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- lō qā·rō·wḇ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’ê·le·ḵā wə·lō yə·ḏa‘·tōw wa·’ă·sap̄·tōw ’el- tō·wḵ bê·ṯe·ḵā wə·hā·yāh ‘im·mə·ḵā ‘aḏ də·rōš ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’ō·ṯōw wa·hă·šê·ḇō·ṯōw lōw
verses.literal: If your brother does not live near you or if you do not know who he is you are to take . . . the animal . . . home to remain with you until your brother comes seeking it then you can return it to him
verses.literalPt: E se teu irmão não estiver perto de ti, ou não o conheceres, recolhê-los-ás na tua casa, para que fiquem contigo, até que teu irmão os busque, e tu lhos restituirás.

verses.original: וְכֵ֧ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֣ה לַחֲמֹר֗וֹ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂה֮ לְשִׂמְלָתוֹ֒ וְכֵ֣ן תַּעֲשֶׂ֜ה לְכָל־ אֲבֵדַ֥ת אָחִ֛יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ תֹּאבַ֥ד מִמֶּ֖נּוּ וּמְצָאתָ֑הּ לֹ֥א תוּכַ֖ל לְהִתְעַלֵּֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śeh la·ḥă·mō·rōw wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śeh lə·śim·lā·ṯōw wə·ḵên ta·‘ă·śeh lə·ḵāl ’ă·ḇê·ḏaṯ ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’ă·šer- tō·ḇaḏ mim·men·nū ū·mə·ṣā·ṯāh lō ṯū·ḵal lə·hiṯ·‘al·lêm
verses.literal: And you shall do the same for his donkey . . . . . . his cloak . . . . . . or anything your brother - . . . has lost and you have found You must not ignore it
verses.literalPt: Assim também farás com o seu jumento, e assim farás com as suas roupas; assim farás também com toda a coisa perdida, que se perder de teu irmão, e tu a achares; não te poderás omitir.

verses.original: לֹא־ תִרְאֶה֩ אֶת־ חֲמ֨וֹר אָחִ֜יךָ א֤וֹ שׁוֹרוֹ֙ נֹפְלִ֣ים בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ וְהִתְעַלַּמְתָּ֖ מֵהֶ֑ם הָקֵ֥ם תָּקִ֖ים עִמּֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯir·’eh ’eṯ- ḥă·mō·wr ’ā·ḥî·ḵā ’ōw šō·w·rōw nō·p̄ə·lîm bad·de·reḵ wə·hiṯ·‘al·lam·tā mê·hem hā·qêm tā·qîm ‘im·mōw
verses.literal: If you see your brother’s donkey or ox fallen on the road you must not ignore it . . . you must help him lift it up . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Se vires o jumento que é de teu irmão, ou o seu boi, caídos no caminho, não te desviarás deles; sem falta o ajudarás a levantá-los.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִהְיֶ֤ה כְלִי־ גֶ֙בֶר֙ עַל־ אִשָּׁ֔ה וְלֹא־ יִלְבַּ֥שׁ גֶּ֖בֶר שִׂמְלַ֣ת אִשָּׁ֑ה כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ כָּל־ עֹ֥שֵׂה אֵֽלֶּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: lō- yih·yeh ḵə·lî- ḡe·ḇer ‘al- ’iš·šāh wə·lō- yil·baš ge·ḇer śim·laṯ ’iš·šāh kî ṯō·w·‘ă·ḇaṯ Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā kāl- ‘ō·śêh ’êl·leh
verses.literal: A woman must not wear . . . men’s clothing and a man must not wear women’s clothing for whoever does these things is detestable to the LORD your God
verses.literalPt: Não haverá traje de homem na mulher, e nem vestirá o homem roupa de mulher; porque, qualquer que faz isto, abominação é ao SENHOR teu Deus.

verses.original: כִּ֣י יִקָּרֵ֣א קַן־ צִפּ֣וֹר׀ לְפָנֶ֡יךָ בַּדֶּ֜רֶךְ בְּכָל־ עֵ֣ץ׀ א֣וֹ עַל־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֶפְרֹחִים֙ א֣וֹ בֵיצִ֔ים וְהָאֵ֤ם רֹבֶ֙צֶת֙ עַל־ הָֽאֶפְרֹחִ֔ים א֖וֹ עַל־ הַבֵּיצִ֑ים לֹא־ תִקַּ֥ח הָאֵ֖ם עַל־ הַבָּנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: kî yiq·qā·rê qan- ṣip·pō·wr lə·p̄ā·ne·ḵā bad·de·reḵ bə·ḵāl ‘êṣ ’ōw ‘al- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ep̄·rō·ḥîm ’ōw ḇê·ṣîm wə·hā·’êm rō·ḇe·ṣeṯ ‘al- hā·’ep̄·rō·ḥîm ’ōw ‘al- hab·bê·ṣîm lō- ṯiq·qaḥ hā·’êm ‘al- hab·bā·nîm
verses.literal: If you come across a bird’s . . . nest with chicks or eggs either in a tree or on the ground along the road . . . and the mother is sitting on the chicks or eggs you must not take the mother . . . along with the young
verses.literalPt: Quando encontrares pelo caminho um ninho de ave numa árvore, ou no chão, com passarinhos, ou ovos, e a mãe posta sobre os passarinhos, ou sobre os ovos, não tomarás a mãe com os filhotes;

verses.original: שַׁלֵּ֤חַ תְּשַׁלַּח֙ אֶת־ הָאֵ֔ם וְאֶת־ הַבָּנִ֖ים תִּֽקַּֽח־ לָ֑ךְ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִ֣יטַב לָ֔ךְ וְהַאֲרַכְתָּ֖ יָמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: šal·lê·aḥ tə·šal·laḥ ’eṯ- hā·’êm wə·’eṯ- hab·bā·nîm tiq·qaḥ- lāḵ lə·ma·‘an yî·ṭaḇ lāḵ wə·ha·’ă·raḵ·tā yā·mîm
verses.literal: You may take the young but be sure to let the mother go . . . so that it may be well with you and that you may prolong your days
verses.literalPt: Deixarás ir livremente a mãe, e os filhotes tomarás para ti; para que te vá bem e para que prolongues os teus dias.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תִבְנֶה֙ בַּ֣יִת חָדָ֔שׁ וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מַעֲקֶ֖ה לְגַגֶּ֑ךָ וְלֹֽא־ תָשִׂ֤ים דָּמִים֙ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ כִּֽי־ יִפֹּ֥ל הַנֹּפֵ֖ל מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ṯiḇ·neh ba·yiṯ ḥā·ḏāš wə·‘ā·śî·ṯā ma·‘ă·qeh lə·ḡag·ge·ḵā wə·lō- ṯā·śîm dā·mîm bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā kî- yip·pōl han·nō·p̄êl mim·men·nū
verses.literal: If you build a new house you are to construct a railing around your roof so that you do not bring bloodguilt on your house if someone falls . . . from it
verses.literalPt: Quando edificares uma casa nova, farás um parapeito, no eirado, para que não ponhas culpa de sangue na tua casa, se alguém de algum modo cair dela.

verses.original: לֹא־ תִזְרַ֥ע כַּרְמְךָ֖ כִּלְאָ֑יִם פֶּן־ תִּקְדַּ֗שׁ הַֽמְלֵאָ֤ה הַזֶּ֙רַע֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּזְרָ֔ע וּתְבוּאַ֖ת הַכָּֽרֶם׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯiz·ra‘ kar·mə·ḵā kil·’ā·yim pen- tiq·daš ham·lê·’āh haz·ze·ra‘ ’ă·šer tiz·rā‘ ū·ṯə·ḇū·’aṯ hak·kā·rem
verses.literal: Do not plant your vineyard with two types of seed if you do the entire harvest will be defiled both the crop you plant and the fruit of your vineyard
verses.literalPt: Não semearás a tua vinha com diferentes espécies de semente, para que não se degenere o fruto da semente que semeares, e a novidade da vinha.

verses.original: לֹֽא־ תַחֲרֹ֥שׁ בְּשׁוֹר־ וּבַחֲמֹ֖ר יַחְדָּֽו׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- ṯa·ḥă·rōš bə·šō·wr- ū·ḇa·ḥă·mōr yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Do not plow with an ox and a donkey yoked together
verses.literalPt: Com boi e com jumento não lavrarás juntamente.

verses.original: לֹ֤א תִלְבַּשׁ֙ שַֽׁעַטְנֵ֔ז צֶ֥מֶר וּפִשְׁתִּ֖ים יַחְדָּֽו׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō ṯil·baš ša·‘aṭ·nêz ṣe·mer ū·p̄iš·tîm yaḥ·dāw
verses.literal: Do not wear clothes of wool and linen woven together
verses.literalPt: Não te vestirás de diversos estofos de lã e linho juntamente.

verses.original: גְּדִלִ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂה־ לָּ֑ךְ עַל־ אַרְבַּ֛ע כַּנְפ֥וֹת כְּסוּתְךָ֖ אֲשֶׁ֥ר תְּכַסֶּה־ בָּֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: gə·ḏi·lîm ta·‘ă·śeh- lāḵ ‘al- ’ar·ba‘ kan·p̄ō·wṯ kə·sū·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer tə·ḵas·seh- bāh
verses.literal: You are to make tassels on the four corners of the cloak you wear
verses.literalPt: Franjas porás nas quatro bordas da tua manta, com que te cobrires.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אִשָּׁ֑ה וּבָ֥א אֵלֶ֖יהָ וּשְׂנֵאָֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yiq·qaḥ ’îš ’iš·šāh ū·ḇā ’ê·le·hā ū·śə·nê·’āh
verses.literal: Suppose a man marries a woman has relations with her and comes to hate her
verses.literalPt: Quando um homem tomar mulher e, depois de coabitar com ela, a desprezar,

verses.original: וְשָׂ֥ם לָהּ֙ עֲלִילֹ֣ת דְּבָרִ֔ים וְהוֹצִ֥יא עָלֶ֖יהָ שֵׁ֣ם רָ֑ע וְאָמַ֗ר אֶת־ הָאִשָּׁ֤ה הַזֹּאת֙ לָקַ֔חְתִּי וָאֶקְרַ֣ב אֵלֶ֔יהָ וְלֹא־ מָצָ֥אתִי לָ֖הּ בְּתוּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·śām lāh ‘ă·lî·lōṯ də·ḇā·rîm wə·hō·w·ṣî ‘ā·le·hā šêm rā‘ wə·’ā·mar ’eṯ- hā·’iš·šāh haz·zōṯ lā·qaḥ·tî wā·’eq·raḇ ’ê·le·hā wə·lō- mā·ṣā·ṯî lāh bə·ṯū·lîm
verses.literal: and he then accuses her of shameful conduct . . . and gives her . . . a bad name saying I married this woman and had relations with her but I discovered she was not a virgin
verses.literalPt: E lhe imputar coisas escandalosas, e contra ela divulgar má fama, dizendo: Tomei esta mulher, e me cheguei a ela, porém não a achei virgem;

verses.original: וְלָקַ֛ח אֲבִ֥י הַנַּעַר וְאִמָּ֑הּ וְהוֹצִ֜יאוּ אֶת־ בְּתוּלֵ֧י הַנַּעַר אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֥י הָעִ֖יר הַשָּֽׁעְרָה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qaḥ ’ă·ḇî han·na·ʿar wə·’im·māh wə·hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- bə·ṯū·lê han·na·ʿar ’el- ziq·nê hā·‘îr haš·šā·‘ə·rāh
verses.literal: Then the young woman’s father and mother shall bring the proof of her virginity to the city elders at the gate
verses.literalPt: Então o pai da moça e sua mãe tomarão os sinais da virgindade da moça, e levá-los-ão aos anciãos da cidade, à porta;

verses.original: וְאָמַ֛ר אֲבִ֥י הַנַּעַר אֶל־ הַזְּקֵנִ֑ים אֶת־ בִּתִּ֗י נָתַ֜תִּי לָאִ֥ישׁ הַזֶּ֛ה לְאִשָּׁ֖ה וַיִּשְׂנָאֶֽהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mar ’ă·ḇî han·na·ʿar ’el- haz·zə·qê·nîm ’eṯ- bit·tî nā·ṯat·tî lā·’îš haz·zeh lə·’iš·šāh way·yiś·nā·’e·hā
verses.literal: and say to the elders I gave my daughter in marriage to this man but he has come to hate her
verses.literalPt: E o pai da moça dirá aos anciãos: Eu dei minha filha por mulher a este homem, porém ele a despreza;

verses.original: וְהִנֵּה־ ה֡וּא שָׂם֩ עֲלִילֹ֨ת דְּבָרִ֜ים לֵאמֹ֗ר לֹֽא־ מָצָ֤אתִי לְבִתְּךָ֙ בְּתוּלִ֔ים וְאֵ֖לֶּה בְּתוּלֵ֣י בִתִּ֑י וּפָֽרְשׂוּ֙ הַשִּׂמְלָ֔ה לִפְנֵ֖י זִקְנֵ֥י הָעִֽיר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hin·nêh- hū śām ‘ă·lî·lōṯ də·ḇā·rîm lê·mōr lō- mā·ṣā·ṯî lə·ḇit·tə·ḵā bə·ṯū·lîm wə·’êl·leh bə·ṯū·lê ḇit·tî ū·p̄ā·rə·śū haś·śim·lāh lip̄·nê ziq·nê hā·‘îr
verses.literal: And now he has accused her of shameful conduct . . . saying I discovered that your daughter was not a virgin But here is the proof of her virginity And they shall spread out the cloth before the city elders
verses.literalPt: E eis que lhe imputou coisas escandalosas, dizendo: Não achei virgem a tua filha; porém eis aqui os sinais da virgindade de minha filha. E estenderão a roupa diante dos anciãos da cidade.

verses.original: וְלָֽקְח֛וּ זִקְנֵ֥י הָֽעִיר־ הַהִ֖וא אֶת־ הָאִ֑ישׁ וְיִסְּר֖וּ אֹתֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lā·qə·ḥū ziq·nê hā·‘îr- ha·hi·w ’eṯ- hā·’îš wə·yis·sə·rū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then the elders of that city shall take the man and punish him
verses.literalPt: Então os anciãos da mesma cidade tomarão aquele homem, e o castigarão.

verses.original: וְעָנְשׁ֨וּ אֹת֜וֹ מֵ֣אָה כֶ֗סֶף וְנָתְנוּ֙ לַאֲבִ֣י הַֽנַּעֲרָ֔ה כִּ֤י הוֹצִיא֙ שֵׁ֣ם רָ֔ע עַ֖ל בְּתוּלַ֣ת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֽוֹ־ תִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֔ה לֹא־ יוּכַ֥ל לְשַּׁלְּחָ֖הּ כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nə·šū ’ō·ṯōw mê·’āh ḵe·sep̄ wə·nā·ṯə·nū la·’ă·ḇî han·na·‘ă·rāh kî hō·w·ṣî šêm rā‘ ‘al bə·ṯū·laṯ yiś·rā·’êl wə·lōw- ṯih·yeh lə·’iš·šāh lō- yū·ḵal ləš·šal·lə·ḥå̄h kāl- yā·māw
verses.literal: They are also to fine him a hundred shekels of silver and give them to the young woman’s father because this man has given a virgin of Israel a bad . . . name And she shall remain his wife he must not . . . divorce her as long as he lives
verses.literalPt: E o multarão em cem siclos de prata, e os darão ao pai da moça; porquanto divulgou má fama sobre uma virgem de Israel. E lhe será por mulher, em todos os seus dias não a poderá despedir.

verses.original: וְאִם־ אֱמֶ֣ת הָיָ֔ה הַדָּבָ֖ר הַזֶּ֑ה לֹא־ נִמְצְא֥וּ בְתוּלִ֖ים לַנַּעַר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- ’ĕ·meṯ hā·yāh had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh lō- nim·ṣə·’ū ḇə·ṯū·lîm lan·na·ʿar
verses.literal: If, however this accusation is true and no proof of the young woman’s virginity can be found
verses.literalPt: Porém se isto for verdadeiro, isto é, que a virgindade não se achou na moça,

verses.original: וְהוֹצִ֨יאוּ אֶת־ הַנַּעַר אֶל־ פֶּ֣תַח בֵּית־ אָבִ֗יהָ וּסְקָלוּהָ֩ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִירָ֤הּ בָּאֲבָנִים֙ וָמֵ֔תָה כִּֽי־ עָשְׂתָ֤ה נְבָלָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לִזְנ֖וֹת בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יהָ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’eṯ- han·na·ʿar ’el- pe·ṯaḥ bêṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā ū·sə·qā·lū·hā ’an·šê ‘î·rāh bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wā·mê·ṯāh kî- ‘ā·śə·ṯāh nə·ḇā·lāh bə·yiś·rā·’êl liz·nō·wṯ bêṯ ’ā·ḇî·hā ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: she shall be brought to the door of her father’s house and there the men of her city will stone her . . . to death For she has committed an outrage in Israel by being promiscuous in her father’s house So you must purge the evil from among you
verses.literalPt: Então levarão a moça à porta da casa de seu pai, e os homens da sua cidade a apedrejarão, até que morra; pois fez loucura em Israel, prostituindo-se na casa de seu pai; assim tirarás o mal do meio de ti.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִמָּצֵ֨א אִ֜ישׁ שֹׁכֵ֣ב׀ עִם־ אִשָּׁ֣ה בְעֻֽלַת־ בַּ֗עַל וּמֵ֙תוּ֙ גַּם־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֔ם הָאִ֛ישׁ הַשֹּׁכֵ֥ב עִם־ הָאִשָּׁ֖ה וְהָאִשָּׁ֑ה וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִיִּשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·mā·ṣê ’îš šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- ’iš·šāh ḇə·‘u·laṯ- ba·‘al ū·mê·ṯū gam- šə·nê·hem hā·’îš haš·šō·ḵêḇ ‘im- hā·’iš·šāh wə·hā·’iš·šāh ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ mî·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: If a man is found lying with another man’s wife . . . both . . . the man who slept with her and the woman must die You must purge the evil from Israel
verses.literalPt: Quando um homem for achado deitado com mulher que tenha marido, então ambos morrerão, o homem que se deitou com a mulher, e a mulher; assim tirarás o mal de Israel.

verses.original: כִּ֤י יִהְיֶה֙ נַעַר בְתוּלָ֔ה מְאֹרָשָׂ֖ה לְאִ֑ישׁ וּמְצָאָ֥הּ אִ֛ישׁ בָּעִ֖יר וְשָׁכַ֥ב עִמָּֽהּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî yih·yeh na·ʿar ḇə·ṯū·lāh mə·’ō·rā·śāh lə·’îš ū·mə·ṣā·’āh ’îš bā·‘îr wə·šā·ḵaḇ ‘im·māh
verses.literal: If there is a virgin pledged in marriage to a man and another man encounters her in the city and sleeps with her
verses.literalPt: Quando houver moça virgem, desposada, e um homem a achar na cidade, e se deitar com ela,

verses.original: וְהוֹצֵאתֶ֨ם אֶת־ שְׁנֵיהֶ֜ם אֶל־ שַׁ֣עַר׀ הָעִ֣יר הַהִ֗וא וּסְקַלְתֶּ֨ם אֹתָ֥ם בָּאֲבָנִים֮ וָמֵתוּ֒ אֶת־ הַנַּעַר עַל־ דְּבַר֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ צָעֲקָ֣ה בָעִ֔יר וְאֶ֨ת־ הָאִ֔ישׁ עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר אֲשֶׁר־ עִנָּ֖ה אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת רֵעֵ֑הוּ וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּֽךָ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ṣê·ṯem ’eṯ- šə·nê·hem ’el- ša·‘ar hā·‘îr ha·hi·w ū·sə·qal·tem ’ō·ṯām bā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wā·mê·ṯū ’eṯ- han·na·ʿar ‘al- də·ḇar ’ă·šer lō- ṣā·‘ă·qāh ḇā·‘îr wə·’eṯ- hā·’îš ‘al- də·ḇar ’ă·šer- ‘in·nāh ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ rê·‘ê·hū ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā
verses.literal: you must take both of them out to the gate of that city and stone them to death the young woman because . . . she did not cry out in the city and the man because . . . he has violated his neighbor’s wife So you must purge the evil from among you
verses.literalPt: Então trareis ambos à porta daquela cidade, e os apedrejareis, até que morram; a moça, porquanto não gritou na cidade, e o homem, porquanto humilhou a mulher do seu próximo; assim tirarás o mal do meio de ti.

verses.original: וְֽאִם־ בַּשָּׂדֶ֞ה יִמְצָ֣א הָאִ֗ישׁ אֶת־ הַנַּעַר הַמְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְהֶחֱזִֽיק־ בָּ֥הּ הָאִ֖ישׁ וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ וּמֵ֗ת הָאִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׁכַ֥ב עִמָּ֖הּ לְבַדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’im- baś·śā·ḏeh yim·ṣā hā·’îš ’eṯ- han·na·ʿar ham·’ō·rā·śāh wə·he·ḥĕ·zîq- bāh hā·’îš wə·šā·ḵaḇ ‘im·māh ū·mêṯ hā·’îš ’ă·šer- šā·ḵaḇ ‘im·māh lə·ḇad·dōw
verses.literal: But if the man encounters a betrothed woman in the open country and he overpowers her and lies with her only the man who has done this . . . must die
verses.literalPt: E se algum homem no campo achar uma moça desposada, e o homem a forçar, e se deitar com ela, então morrerá só o homem que se deitou com ela;

verses.original: וְלַנַּעַר לֹא־ תַעֲשֶׂ֣ה דָבָ֔ר אֵ֥ין לַנַּעַר חֵ֣טְא מָ֑וֶת כִּ֡י כַּאֲשֶׁר֩ יָק֨וּם אִ֤ישׁ עַל־ רֵעֵ֙הוּ֙ וּרְצָח֣וֹ נֶ֔פֶשׁ כֵּ֖ן הַדָּבָ֥ר הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lan·na·ʿar lō- ṯa·‘ă·śeh ḏā·ḇār ’ên lan·na·ʿar ḥêṭ mā·weṯ kî ka·’ă·šer yā·qūm ’îš ‘al- rê·‘ê·hū ū·rə·ṣā·ḥōw ne·p̄eš kên had·dā·ḇār haz·zeh
verses.literal: Do nothing . . . to the young woman because she has committed no sin worthy of death This case is just like one in which a man . . . attacks his neighbor and murders him . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Porém à moça não farás nada. A moça não tem culpa de morte; porque, como o homem que se levanta contra o seu próximo, e lhe tira a vida, assim é este caso.

verses.original: כִּ֥י בַשָּׂדֶ֖ה מְצָאָ֑הּ צָעֲקָ֗ה הַנַּעַר הַמְאֹ֣רָשָׂ֔ה וְאֵ֥ין מוֹשִׁ֖יעַ לָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḇaś·śā·ḏeh mə·ṣā·’āh ṣā·‘ă·qāh han·na·ʿar ham·’ō·rā·śāh wə·’ên mō·wō·šî·a‘ lāh
verses.literal: When he found her in the field the betrothed woman cried out but there was no one to save her
verses.literalPt: Pois a achou no campo; a moça desposada gritou, e não houve quem a livrasse.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ יִמְצָ֣א אִ֗ישׁ נַעַר בְתוּלָה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ אֹרָ֔שָׂה וּתְפָשָׂ֖הּ וְשָׁכַ֣ב עִמָּ֑הּ וְנִמְצָֽאוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·ṣā ’îš na·ʿar ḇə·ṯū·lāh ’ă·šer lō- ’ō·rā·śāh ū·ṯə·p̄ā·śāh wə·šā·ḵaḇ ‘im·māh wə·nim·ṣā·’ū
verses.literal: If a man encounters a virgin who is not pledged in marriage and he seizes her and lies with her and they are discovered
verses.literalPt: Quando um homem achar uma moça virgem, que não for desposada, e pegar nela, e se deitar com ela, e forem apanhados,

verses.original: וְ֠נָתַן הָאִ֨ישׁ הַשֹּׁכֵ֥ב עִמָּ֛הּ לַאֲבִ֥י הַנַּעַר חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים כָּ֑סֶף וְלֽוֹ־ תִהְיֶ֣ה לְאִשָּׁ֗ה תַּ֚חַת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עִנָּ֔הּ לֹא־ יוּכַ֥ל שַׁלְּחָ֖ה כָּל־ יָמָֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·nā·ṯan hā·’îš haš·šō·ḵêḇ ‘im·māh la·’ă·ḇî han·na·ʿar ḥă·miš·šîm kā·sep̄ wə·lōw- ṯih·yeh lə·’iš·šāh ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ‘in·nāh lō- yū·ḵal šal·lə·ḥå̄h kāl- yā·māw
verses.literal: then the man who lay with her must pay the young woman’s father fifty shekels of silver and she must become his wife because he has violated her He must not . . . divorce her as long as he lives
verses.literalPt: Então o homem que se deitou com ela dará ao pai da moça cinqüenta siclos de prata; e porquanto a humilhou, lhe será por mulher; não a poderá despedir em todos os seus dias.

verses.original: לֹא־ יִקַּ֥ח אִ֖ישׁ אֶת־ אֵ֣שֶׁת אָבִ֑יו וְלֹ֥א יְגַלֶּ֖ה כְּנַ֥ף אָבִֽיו׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- yiq·qaḥ ’îš ’eṯ- ’ê·šeṯ ’ā·ḇîw wə·lō yə·ḡal·leh kə·nap̄ ’ā·ḇîw
verses.literal: A man is not to marry his father’s wife so that he will not dishonor his father’s marriage bed
verses.literalPt: Nenhum homem tomará a mulher de seu pai, nem descobrirá a nudez de seu pai.
